    def complete_log_via_chat(self, message: str, expected_value: str, timeout: int = 15000):
    	"""Send a free-form log message and confirm via the chatbot flow.
    
    	`timeout` (ms) governs all waits in this flow: composer becoming
    	enabled, the bot's confirmation prompt, and the success message.
    	Override per call-site if a particular environment needs longer.
    	"""
    	self.page.reload()
    	self.page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    	if not self.page.locator(self.COMPOSER).first.is_visible():
    		self.open_chat_with_habi()
    	composer = self.page.locator(self.COMPOSER).first
    	composer.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
    	composer.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
    	# Composer can render before it's actually interactive (panel content
    	# still streaming in). Wait until it's enabled, then verify the fill
    	# actually landed before relying on it.
    	composer.wait_for(state="attached", timeout=timeout)
    	self.page.wait_for_function(
    		"el => !el.disabled",
    		arg=composer.element_handle(),
    		timeout=timeout,
    	)
    	composer.click()
    	composer.fill(message)
    	assert composer.input_value() == message, (
    		f"Composer did not accept the message. Expected '{message}', "
    		f"but composer contains '{composer.input_value()}'"
    	)
    	self.page.locator(self.SEND_BTN_ICON).first.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
    	self.page.locator(self.SEND_BTN_ICON).first.click()
    	self.page.locator(self.CONFIRMATION_PROMPT).first.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
    	composer.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
    	composer.click()
    	composer.fill("Yes")
    	assert composer.input_value() == "Yes", (
    		f"Composer did not accept 'Yes'. Composer contains '{composer.input_value()}'"
    	)
    	self.page.locator(self.SEND_BTN).first.click()
    	self.page.locator(self.SUCCESS_MESSAGE).wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
    	weight_value = expected_value.split(":")[-1].strip()
    	bot_messages = self.page.locator(self.CONFIRMATION_PROMPT).all()
    	actual_text = " ".join(
    		(msg.text_content() or "").strip() for msg in bot_messages
    	)
